items.t: Air bag sensing module may fail (recall 07V-062)
items.job: Replace or reprogram airbag sensing module
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a GMC dealer.

items.t: Wiper linkage may come off the motor (recall 08V-410)
items.job: Reattach or replace windshield wiper linkage
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a GMC dealer.

items.t: Lost 3rd, 5th and reverse gears (GM special coverage 14404B)
items.job: Rebuild transmission with updated 3-5-R wave plate
items.note: Was covered by GM special coverage; ask a dealer. A remanufactured transmission costs much more.

items.t: Heated windshield washer module can overheat and catch fire (recalls 08V-441, 10V-240)
items.job: Disable heated washer module and install bypass harness
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a GMC dealer.

items.t: Power liftgate struts wear and the gate can drop (recall 15V-415)
items.job: Replace both liftgate gas struts
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a GMC dealer.

items.t: Timing chain stretch (GM bulletin 12-06-01-009A)
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: Cost rises a lot if the chain jumped and damaged the engine.

items.t: A/C evaporator leaks
items.job: Replace A/C evaporator core and recharge system
items.note: The rear evaporator is often easier to reach than the front one in the dash.

items.t: Water leak from the sunroof into the headliner (GM bulletin 10-08-67-001C)
items.job: Clear and reseal sunroof drain tubes
items.note: If the headliner must come down or wet wiring needs repair, expect more.

items.t: Service Air Bag warning from seat wiring (recall 14V-118)
items.job: Repair side airbag wiring connectors under the front seats
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a GMC dealer.

items.t: Shift cable clip may not be fully seated (recall 09V-073)
items.job: Inspect and reseat shift cable clip
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a GMC dealer.

items.t: Front seat belt cable can break (recall 14V-266)
items.job: Replace front seat belt buckle assembly
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN. Price is per seat.

items.t: Wiper arm can loosen from snow and ice (recall 12V-151)
items.job: Replace or retighten windshield wiper arm nuts
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a GMC dealer.

items.t: Side curtain airbags may not be attached properly (recall 21V-246)
items.job: Inspect and re-secure side curtain airbags
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a GMC dealer.

items.t: Shift cable adjuster may come off the lever (recall 14V-092)
items.job: Install retainer on shift cable adjuster
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a GMC dealer.

items.t: Fuel gauge may read wrong (recall 14V-223)
items.job: Reprogram instrument cluster software
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a GMC dealer.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator may rupture (recalls 23V-334, 22V-246)
items.job: Replace driver front airbag module
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a GMC dealer.

items.t: Windshield wiper motor can overheat (recall 15V-609)
items.job: Replace windshield wiper motor
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a GMC dealer.

items.t: Front brake caliper seal may be damaged (recall 16V-802)
items.job: Replace front brake calipers and bleed brakes
items.note: Price is for both front calipers. Usually free under the recall; check your VIN.

items.t: Front driveshaft can break (recall 17V-516)
items.job: Replace front right half shaft
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a GMC dealer.

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump may come loose (recall 18V-358)
items.job: Inspect and tighten or replace high-pressure fuel pump
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN. Most need only new bolts; a new pump costs more.

items.t: Shift to Park message when already in Park (GM bulletin 19-NA-206)
items.job: Replace shifter park switch or shifter harness
items.note: A dealer repair per the bulletin. Not a recall, but ask about goodwill help.

items.t: Start/stop accumulator end cap may be missing bolts (recall 20V-668)
items.job: Install missing accumulator cover bolts and refill fluid
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN. Cost rises a lot if the transmission was damaged.

items.t: Roof-rail airbag inflator part may separate (recall 20V-446)
items.job: Replace roof-rail airbag
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN. Price is per side.

items.t: Backup camera image may fail (recall 22V-709)
items.job: Replace rearview camera
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a GMC dealer.

items.t: Fuel supply lines may not be attached properly (recall 21V-422)
items.job: Reconnect fuel supply lines and check for leaks
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a GMC dealer.

items.t: Airbag module may have been left inactive (recall 21V-702)
items.job: Reprogram airbag module
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a GMC dealer.

items.t: Rear toe link may not be tightened (recall 22V-427)
items.job: Torque rear toe link bolts and align wheels
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a GMC dealer.

items.t: Front half-shaft may disconnect (recalls 23V-043, 23V-172)
items.job: Replace front half shaft
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a GMC dealer.

items.t: Windshield may not be bonded properly (recall 23V-681)
items.job: Remove and reinstall windshield with new adhesive
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN. The windshield camera may need recalibration.

items.t: Shudder or vibration from the automatic transmission
items.job: Transmission fluid exchange, torque converter if needed
items.note: Low end is the bulletin fluid service; high end is replacing the torque converter.
